text_block_list.text: The day of Bamboo Memory's debut race has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Bamboo-san.
I will bear witness from right here."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Your debut race.
That running of yours—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run, wanna run, wanna run!
I wanna run so badly I can't stand ittt!!!
Nuaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!!
Spirit! Stamina! A pinch of composure!
Motivation! Passion! All systems go!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For this debut race, holding what Trainer taught me
close to my heart, I'm gonna give it everything I've got!!
